playground.name: Your future AI friend
playground.try: What shall we talk about? Pick an example:

scenarios.label: An idea, please
scenarios.user: What can I give a friend who has everything?
scenarios.bot: How about an experience? Map out a walk through your favorite places together, with a little surprise waiting at the end.

scenarios.label: Make it simple
scenarios.user: Why don't clouds fall? Keep it simple.
scenarios.bot: They're made of tiny water droplets. Those drops are so light that rising air holds them up, a little like the wind carrying a feather.

scenarios.label: Help me plan
scenarios.user: I want to read more, but I keep putting it off.
scenarios.bot: Let's start small: ten minutes and one interesting book. Pair it with your evening tea. What kind of stories do you like?

botFeatures.eyebrow: For big ideas and little everyday things

faq.title: A little curious already?
faq.subtitle: Get to know your future AI friend: what it can do, where it lives, and how pricing works.

items.question: Which messenger can the bot use?
items.answer: We can consider connecting the assistant to your chosen messenger if it provides a technical integration option. We confirm connection availability and timing after your request.

items.question: What can the basic bot do?
items.answer: It provides AI chat 24/7, answers questions, and helps with writing and ideas. We configure its role and style, select an AI model, and issue separate protected access.

items.question: Does it include memory, voice, and file handling?
items.answer: Those features are not part of the verified base. If you truly need them, we will estimate them as separate extensions and agree on them before development starts.

items.question: How much does setup cost?
items.answer: The price depends on the selected messenger and configuration. We clarify the task after your request and quote before work begins; there is no single fixed setup price.

items.question: How are AI requests paid for after launch?
items.answer: A package of 100 internal credits costs RUB 600 and is spent as AI features are used. The package does not pay for bot development or its initial connection.

items.question: How is my data handled?
items.answer: Lead data and prompts are processed only as needed to contact you and operate the service. Full details are available in the personal data processing policy.

lead.title: What will your AI friend be like?
lead.subtitle: A calm conversation partner, a source of unexpected ideas, or a helper with a sense of humor? Tell us what feels right, and we'll discuss setup, your messenger, and the connection price.
lead.privacyNote: We check your request for spam and send it by email. Its text and contact details are not stored in the website database.
